title: BLUEBERRY BLAST STORM – VAPEHUB ULTRA 20000
description: BLUEBERRY BLAST STORM is an exhilarating experience that sweeps you off your feet with its vibrant burst of flavour. This flavour encapsulates the essence of fresh blueberries, intensified by a whirlwind of tangy notes that create an electrifying sensation on your palate. Each puff delivers a refreshing blast, invigorating and uplifting your spirit.
